geeklist.title: Winter Chill Auction
geeklist.description:
It's cold out there! Better to shop for your games online and place your bids on great games my friends and I are auctioning off!
[b]PLEASE READ BEFORE BIDDING![/b]
[b]Auction will end [b] Tuesday February 17, 2026[/b] at approximately [b]10pm EST[/b]. Anti-sniping is in effect and individual items can be bid on 30 minutes after the last bid. [/b]
Auction is open to residents of [u]Canada[/u] and [u]US[/u]. Shipping will be provided by [url=https://stallionexpress.ca/]Stallion Express[/url] to give you the best price for shipping. If you win multiple items, I will bundle the games together to save you more on shipping.
I am open to trades but only from what is in my[b] [geekurl=/wishlist/andykim88]wishlist[/geekurl][/b].
Games have a minimum bid - I will NOT sell at lower than this price.
Local porch pickup and drop off options available as well for local residents in the [b]Vaughan/Richmond Hill[/b] and [b]Toronto[/b] border as well as in the parking lots of [b]401 Games Vaughan[/b], [b]Board Game Bliss[/b] and [b]Wood For Sheep[/b] stores. Can also meet in the vicinity of Fairview Mall or Yorkdale Mall as well Kennedy and Finch area on certain days.
[b]All bids must be in whole dollars in CAD currency. Payment will be received via eTransfer in Canada and PayPal in US (PayPal buyers MUST use "Send to Friend" option)[/b]
I am not responsible for damages incurred during the shipping of the game however I will use adequate padding on the games to ensure no additional minor dents or dings occur than what is indicated in the listing if any (I have not had any issues in the several years I've been doing this for!)
%SHIPSFROM%Vaughan, Ontario %SHIPSTO%Canada, US %AUCTIONEND%September 23, 2024
